body: At Clearwater Logistics' warehouse in Limerick, the annual stock count used to take 30 employees a full weekend.
This year, the job was done in just six hours by four small robots that move along the aisles and scan every shelf with cameras.
'Staff no longer have to work long weekend shifts,' said warehouse manager Aoife Lynch. 'Instead, they check the robots' results and investigate any differences.'
The company plans to introduce the robots at its two other warehouses by next summer.
